parentNote.en: Every question is answered in the app. Each goal has a short home activity: say the words aloud together, and let your child guess first.
parentNote.ar: كل الأسئلة الطفل بيحلها جوه البرنامج، ولكل هدف نشاط قصير في البيت. قولوا الكلمات بصوت عالي مع بعض، وسيبوا طفلك يتوقع الأول.

steps.title: {name}'s day
steps.prompt: Tap each part of the recount to listen.

options.label: Then, I played football with my friends.
At last, I came home and ate my dinner.

steps.explanation: A recount tells what really happened, in order, with time words like First and Then.
steps.shortExplanation: A recount tells what really happened, in order, with time words like First and Then.

englishVisual.title: My day
englishVisual.text: A true recount, told in order.

steps.title: Time machine words

options.label: A recount is true, and it has already happened.
The little ending ed sends a word into the past: walk, walked. Play, played.
A noun is a person, a place or a thing. A verb is a doing word.

steps.explanation: Past verbs often end in ed. Nouns are things; verbs are doing words.
steps.shortExplanation: Past verbs often end in ed. Nouns are things; verbs are doing words.

englishVisual.text: Yesterday, I walked to the park.

steps.title: Capital letters
steps.prompt: Tap the words that need a capital letter.
steps.hint: Find the word I, the name of a place and the name of a person.
steps.explanation: I, Cairo and Sara need capitals: the word I, a place and a name.
steps.shortExplanation: I, Cairo and Sara need capitals: the word I, a place and a name.

source.answerKeyText: I went to Cairo with Sara. (I, Cairo and Sara all need capitals.)

englishVisual.text: i went to cairo with sara.

steps.title: Time words
steps.prompt: Match each part of the recount to its time word.
steps.hint: What do you do first at bedtime, and what happens at the very end?
steps.explanation: First I brushed my teeth, then I got into bed, and at last I fell asleep.
steps.shortExplanation: First I brushed my teeth, then I got into bed, and at last I fell asleep.

steps.title: It already happened
steps.prompt: Tap the three verbs that tell us it has already happened.
steps.hint: Say each one after Yesterday: Yesterday we went…
steps.explanation: Went, walked and helped tell us it already happened.
steps.shortExplanation: Went, walked and helped tell us it already happened.

source.answerKeyText: a went • b walked • c helped

steps.title: Add ed
steps.prompt: Yesterday I play… football. Write the ending.
steps.hint: It already happened. Which ending sends a word into the past?
steps.explanation: Yesterday I played football. The ending ed means it already happened.
steps.shortExplanation: Yesterday I played football. The ending ed means it already happened.

source.answerKeyText: plays, playing, played • jumps, jumping, jumped

steps.title: Add ing
steps.prompt: I am jump… right now. Write the ending.
steps.hint: It is happening now, after I am.
steps.explanation: I am jumping. The ending ing means it is happening now.
steps.shortExplanation: I am jumping. The ending ing means it is happening now.

source.answerKeyText: plays, playing, played • jumps, jumping, jumped

steps.title: Noun or verb?
steps.prompt: Is each word a noun or a verb?
steps.hint: Can you do it? Then it is a verb. Can you point to it? Then it is a noun.
steps.explanation: Dog, school and apple are nouns. Run, jump and swim are doing words, verbs.
steps.shortExplanation: Dog, school and apple are nouns. Run, jump and swim are doing words, verbs.

source.answerKeyText: Nouns: dog, school, apple • Verbs: run, jump, swim

steps.title: Join with and
steps.prompt: I like juice. I like milk. Which one joins them with and?
steps.hint: And goes between the two things you like.
steps.explanation: And joins two ideas in one sentence: I like juice and milk.
steps.shortExplanation: And joins two ideas in one sentence: I like juice and milk.

source.answerKeyText: I like juice and milk. ("I like juice and I like milk." is also right.)

steps.title: True or false?
steps.prompt: Is each sentence true or false?

options.label: A recount tells about something that has already happened.
A recount uses time words like First and Then.
A recount is about a monster who lives in the washing machine.

steps.hint: Is a monster in the washing machine real?
steps.explanation: A recount is true and uses time words. A monster story is fantasy, not a recount.
steps.shortExplanation: A recount is true and uses time words. A monster story is fantasy, not a recount.

source.answerKeyText: a T • b T • c F — that is a fantasy story, not a recount.

steps.title: Yesterday, I…
steps.prompt: Tap the words in order to make a sentence about yesterday.
steps.hint: Start with Yesterday and a comma, then I.
steps.explanation: Yesterday, I played in the park. Played tells us it already happened.
steps.shortExplanation: Yesterday, I played in the park. Played tells us it already happened.

source.answerKeyText: Two true sentences about yesterday, with past verbs (went, played, ate) and capital letters and full stops.

steps.title: What is a recount?
steps.prompt: A recount tells about something that…
steps.hint: Think of telling Mum about your day at school.
steps.explanation: A recount tells about something that has already happened.
steps.shortExplanation: A recount tells about something that has already happened.

steps.title: Always a capital
steps.prompt: Which word always has a capital letter?
steps.hint: It is the word for me.
steps.explanation: When it means me, I is always a capital letter.
steps.shortExplanation: When it means me, I is always a capital letter.

steps.title: Yesterday
steps.explanation: Yesterday I jumped over the rope. Jumped ends in ed for the past.
steps.shortExplanation: Yesterday I jumped over the rope. Jumped ends in ed for the past.

steps.title: What is a noun?
steps.hint: Mum, school and ball are all nouns.
steps.explanation: A noun is a person, a place or a thing: Mum, school, ball.
steps.shortExplanation: A noun is a person, a place or a thing: Mum, school, ball.

steps.title: The word Then
steps.hint: It tells us when something happened in a recount.
steps.explanation: Then is a time word. It tells us what happened next.
steps.shortExplanation: Then is a time word. It tells us what happened next.

stickers.meaning: Telling something true that already happened.

goalActivities.text: Make a postcard from a cereal box. Your child writes two sentences about a real day out and colours each capital letter.
goalActivities.textAr: اعملوا كارت بوستال من علبة كورن فليكس. طفلك يكتب جملتين عن يوم حقيقي خرجتوا فيه، ويلوّن كل حرف كبير.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: At bedtime, tell the steps together: First…, Then…, At last…. Your child holds up a finger for each one.
goalActivities.textAr: وقت النوم احكوا الخطوات مع بعض: First… و Then… و At last…. وطفلك يرفع صباع مع كل واحدة.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Play "yesterday": you say a doing word, like walk or jump, and your child says it as if it was yesterday: walked, jumped.
goalActivities.textAr: العبوا "yesterday": تقول فعل زي walk أو jump، وطفلك يقوله كأنه حصل امبارح: walked و jumped.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Walk across the room and say: I walk. Mum walks. I am walking. Stop: I walked! Then your child does it with jump, hop and clap.
goalActivities.textAr: امشي في الأوضة وقول: I walk. Mum walks. I am walking. وقّف: I walked! وبعدين طفلك يعملها مع jump و hop و clap.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Make word cards: dog, run, school, jump, apple, swim. Sort them into things and doing words, then make silly sentences: The dog swims.
goalActivities.textAr: اعملوا كروت كلمات: dog و run و school و jump و apple و swim. قسموها حاجات وأفعال، وبعدين اعملوا جمل تضحّك: The dog swims.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: At breakfast, make long sentences with and: I like bread and cheese. Mum likes tea and Dad likes coffee.
goalActivities.textAr: على الفطار اعملوا جمل طويلة بـ and: I like bread and cheese. Mum likes tea and Dad likes coffee.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Tell your child one true thing and one made-up thing about your day. They guess which one is the recount.
goalActivities.textAr: احكي لطفلك حاجة حقيقية وحاجة متألفة عن يومك، وهو يخمّن أنهي واحدة هي الـ recount.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Your child tells you two things they did yesterday. Write them together, starting with Yesterday, I…, with capital letters and full stops.
goalActivities.textAr: طفلك يحكيلك حاجتين عملهم امبارح، واكتبوهم مع بعض وابدأوا بـ Yesterday, I…، بحروف كبيرة ونقط.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: When your child comes home, ask: what happened today? Then say: you just did a recount!
goalActivities.textAr: لما طفلك يرجع البيت اسأله: حصل إيه النهارده؟ وبعدين قوله: إنت لسه عامل recount!
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Write a few sentences with I in them. Your child hunts for every I and checks it is a capital.
goalActivities.textAr: اكتب كام جملة فيها I، وطفلك يدوّر على كل I ويتأكد إنها حرف كبير.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Jump over a rope or a line on the floor. After each jump your child says: I jumped!
goalActivities.textAr: نطوا فوق حبل أو خط على الأرض، وبعد كل نطة طفلك يقول: I jumped!
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Play noun hunt in the house: your child touches five things and names them. Each one is a noun.
goalActivities.textAr: العبوا تدوير على الأسماء في البيت: طفلك يلمس خمس حاجات ويقول اسمها، كل واحدة فيهم noun.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Tell a short recount together and clap every time you hear a time word: First, Then, Next, At last.
goalActivities.textAr: احكوا recount قصيرة مع بعض، وصقفوا كل ما تسمعوا كلمة وقت: First و Then و Next و At last.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

homeActivities.text: Every evening at dinner, your child tells their day on three fingers: First…, Then…, At last…. Repeat their past verbs back with a smile.
homeActivities.textAr: كل يوم على العشا، طفلك يحكي يومه على تلات صوابع: First… و Then… و At last…. وانت كرر الأفعال الماضية وراه وانت مبتسم.
homeActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
homeActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.
